page_title: RAY 0-0 BET | Rayo Vallecano v Betis 15/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' What a great effort! Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to beat Alvaro Valles with a header from the corner kick. He sends his effort towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same.
90+2' Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
83' A substitution has been made. Isi Palazon is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Here is a change. Alvaro Garcia is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
78' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' Antony (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' The foul by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo De Burgos.
74' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Sergi Altimira (Betis) replaces Pablo Fornals.
74' Rodrigo Riquelme comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Garcia (Betis).
72' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
66' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Valentin will be replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
66' Substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pacha.
65' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) meets a brilliant cross and steers a fine header goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post.
64' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
59' Substitution. Nelson Deossa will be replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
57' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' A pass from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Alvaro Valles and the move breaks down.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

49' A nice pass finds Aitor Ruibal (Betis) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top right corner, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
49' Antony (Betis) takes the corner with a short pass.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+5' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
45+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Ricardo De Burgos shows the yellow card to Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Antony (Betis) commits a foul and Ricardo De Burgos immediately signals a free kick.
43' Looks like Marc Bartra (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
41' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
40' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
39' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
36' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Alvaro Valles.
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
28' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.

28' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) drills his free kick effort towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles is well prepared and makes a good block to stop the ball from crossing the goal line.
27' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) brings an opponent down and Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
26' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post.
24' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Alvaro Valles makes a comfortable save.
24' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
18' Jorge de Frutos is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
16' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
11' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.

10' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a long run up and smashes the free kick at goal, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Marc Roca (Betis) for a tough tackle.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
7' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Diego Llorente is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Marc Bartra (Betis).
6' Diego Llorente (Betis) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
5' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.

5' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
1' Pablo Fornals (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Augusto Batalla easily deals with the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ricardo De Burgos.
